title: East Nashville Urban Escape - Guest House
description:
Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space. Newly constructed, this private getaway in the heart of historic East Nashville offers the ideal blend of comfort, privacy, and convenience. Just a short walk away from some of Nashville's best coffee shops, bars, and restaurants. Minutes from downtown, yet quiet and accessible to everything! Boasts a full-size kitchen to cook delicious meals and a calming outdoor entertainment space that's ready for your arrival!

The space
This brand new, beautifully decorated guest house is tucked into a quiet corner of exciting East Nashville. Clean, stylish, and completely equipped for a restful escape, you'll have your own private world all to yourself, right in the center of the action. Enjoy the soaring vaulted ceilings, large fully stocked kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and beautifully renovated bathroom. We can accommodate up to four guests, with a king bed in the bedroom and queen-sized sofa bed in the living room.  

Grill outdoors or enjoy an evening around the firepit in the serene backyard patio area. For indoor entertainment, enjoy a movie on the 65" 4K UHD smart TV, throw a record on the record player, or play a board game during a cozy night in. For those needing to catch up on work or emails, we provide high-speed Wi-Fi.

The apartment is within walking distance to countless great restaurants, coffee shops, and bars! Just over a block away from the hip tiki bar Pearl Diver and a Publix grocery store. 

We've thoughtfully equipped the home with a premium mattress and crisp clean linens with plenty of amenities to make your stay as comfortable and enjoyable as possible.

Guest access
Guests have private access to the second story 700 sq ft apartment, gravel patio area, and parking pad. Additional free off-street parking also available.

We live in the main house on the same property. Feel free to say hello or just enjoy your private space. While we access the garage below, the structure is well insulated to minimize any noise from garage doors, etc.

Other things to note
- Enjoy stress free parking with off-street parking pad for up to two cars 
- Alley entrance to the apartment
- Property located above detached garage
